basis: During the authorized concurrency handoff, all437started attempts ended but13gateway requests remained pending for several minutes. Every associated attempt is a terminal failure. Waiting for unrelated orphan sockets cannot improve these already-ended episodes.
requirements: No active formal episodes; owned launch pause
Every pending request belongs to a frozen-plan episode with completed=false and terminal status older than60seconds
Gateway thread count equals one listener plus the recorded pending requests
Save immutable request and attempt-status hashes before old gateway shutdown
effects: Only allow the previously prepared gateway handoff to close orphan sockets. Preserve original request evidence, terminal failures and missing usage. No replacement calls, score changes or new formal runs.
